scope: Original synthetic diagnostic for genre and claim-scope decisions, not a real-paper holdout

facts.text: Synthetic Method Q uses adaptive action segments for simulated manipulation. On two fixed tasks at the same training budget it succeeds in 72 and 65 of 100 executions, versus 60 and 58 for fixed-length segments. No independent-training-run uncertainty is provided.
On the measured workstation, Method Q requires 108 ms per action chunk versus 96 ms for the comparison policy. No physical-robot or new-environment policy evaluations have been performed.

The author plans to release a reusable encoder and assess its encoding fidelity on excluded simulators without refitting. Release and excluded-simulator evaluation have not occurred; no result for either is available.
